frozen_law.metric: Pearson correlation between signed close-to-close return ending at t and signed close-to-close return from t to t+h
frozen_law.data_rule: Require every M5 interval from t-1 through t+h to be exactly 300 seconds; skip gaps and zero-price rows. Use log returns. Report observation counts and correlations for every accepted symbol and aggregate pooled observations, with no parameter search.
frozen_law.interpretation: Descriptive serial dependence for mean-reversion versus momentum mechanism availability only; no return magnitude/PnL, commission, economic candidate, symbol promotion, protected-forward inference or family closure.

reasoning: The accepted development M5 bytes support a schedule-independent structural screen while the C006 cash-session calendar prerequisite remains unresolved. Fixed natural M5/M15/M30 horizons quantify whether broad serial dependence is present without retuning C032 or consuming an attempt.
